assessment_summary: The statement incorrectly claims the bound (5n-10)/3 for all planar simple graphs containing a cycle. This bound actually applies to planar graphs with girth >= 5. The triangle graph (C_3) has 3 vertices and 3 edges, which strictly exceeds the formula's bound of 5/3.
counterexample: The cycle graph C_3 (a triangle) has n = 3 vertices and m = 3 edges. It is a connected planar simple graph containing at least one cycle. The formula gives an upper bound of (5(3) - 10)/3 = 5/3 edges. Since 3 > 5/3, C_3 violates the conclusion.
